Você está muito perto! Comece no 2. Agora, conte 1, 2, 3... até 9 marcas para a direita (cada marca é 1/12). A nona marca após o 2 é o ponto certo!

nodes.description: Enter the whole-number part of the mixed number after converting 33/12.
nodes.instruction: Enter the whole-number part of the mixed number after converting 33/12.

hints.message: Compare the numerator with the denominator to decide whether the fraction contains complete wholes.
Divide the numerator by the denominator and record the number of complete groups.
Two complete groups of twelve use 24 pens, while three groups would use 36 pens.
Enter the number of complete groups of twelve in m1.

misconceptions.description: Aluno arredonda ou despreza a parte fracionária ao posicionar na reta
misconceptions.feedback: You did not count all the complete groups of twelve. Check how many full dozens fit into 33 pens.

misconceptions.description: Erro clássico de contagem: confunde marcas com intervalos, terminando uma fração antes
misconceptions.feedback: You counted one complete dozen too many. Three dozens would require 36 pens, which is more than Katie has.

nodes.description: Enter the numerator of the fractional part of the mixed number.
nodes.instruction: Enter the numerator of the fractional part of the mixed number.

hints.message: After removing the complete dozens, the remainder becomes the numerator of the fractional part.
Multiply the whole-number part by the denominator, then subtract that product from the original numerator.
The complete dozens account for 24 pens. Find how many pens remain from the original total.
Subtract the pens in two complete dozens from the total and enter the remainder in m2.

misconceptions.description: Aluno assume que 'a fração' se refere à parte menor que 1 do número misto, ignorando a fração imprópria dada
misconceptions.feedback: You repeated the original numerator instead of finding the remainder after removing the complete dozens.

misconceptions.description: Aluno confunde a quantidade original com a fração que representa essa quantidade em dúzias
misconceptions.feedback: You used the size of a dozen rather than the number of pens left after two complete dozens.

nodes.description: Estimate the fraction's position on the number line from 0 to 3.
nodes.instruction: Estimate the fraction's position on the number line from 0 to 3.

hints.message: Use the complete dozens first, then locate the remaining fractional part within the next unit.
Start at the whole-number part and move through the indicated number of twelfth intervals.
The point lies between 2 and 3 and is nine of the twelve equal spaces after 2.
Place the estimate three quarters of the way from 2 toward 3.

misconceptions.description: Erro clássico de contagem: confunde marcas com intervalos, terminando uma fração antes
misconceptions.feedback: You counted the starting mark as the first interval. Count the spaces after 2; nine spaces place the point at 2.75.

misconceptions.description: Aluno posiciona apenas a parte fracionária na reta, esquecendo os inteiros, porque interpretou mal qual era a fração alvo
misconceptions.feedback: You placed only the fractional part and forgot the two complete dozens. The point must be between 2 and 3.

misconceptions.description: Aluno usa raciocínio de 'quanto falta' (gap thinking) e estima incorretamente como metade
misconceptions.feedback: You placed the point halfway between 2 and 3. Nine of twelve parts is more than half of the interval.

misconceptions.description: Aluno arredonda ou despreza a parte fracionária ao posicionar na reta
misconceptions.feedback: You used only the whole-number part and ignored the remaining nine twelfths. Move to the right of 2.

misconceptions.description: Aluno não reconhece que a reta está escalada em dúzias (cada unidade = 1 dúzia = 12 canetas) e trata como se fosse contagem direta
misconceptions.feedback: You treated the numerator as a direct number-line coordinate. This number line measures dozens, so the position is between 2 and 3.

misconceptions.description: Aluno arredonda ou despreza a parte fracionária ao posicionar na reta
misconceptions.feedback: You marked the whole-number part but left out the fractional remainder. Move nine twelfth-spaces to the right.
